name: castle_600
doc: 600 A.D.: Crono walks the overworld to Guardia Forest (loc 077, south entry), wins the forest ambush, leaves by the north edge and enters Guardia Castle (loc 078); the guards' challenge and 'Queen Leene' (Marle) vouching for him (storyline 0C -> 0F). Crono free in the entrance hall.
